translations.text: For Christ did not send me to baptize but to proclaim the good news, not with wisdom of speech, so that the cross of Christ would not be emptied of its power.
For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are going to perish, but to us who are going to be saved, it is the power of God.
Where is the wise person? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Has not God made the wisdom of the world foolish?
For since, in the wisdom of God, the world did not know God through wisdom, God was pleased to save those who believe through the foolishness of preaching.
For consider your calling, my brothers: not many of you are wise by human standards, not many are powerful, and not many are of noble birth.
And I too, when I came to you, my brothers, did not come with lofty speech or wisdom as I proclaimed the testimony of God to you.
So it does not depend on the one who plants or the one who waters, but on God, who makes it grow.
For we are God's fellow workers. You are God's field, God's building.
Anyone whose work—the work he has built—remains will receive a reward.
For everything belongs to you: whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas, whether the world or life or death, whether present things or things to come—everything belongs to you.
Let the husband give his wife what he owes her, and likewise let the wife give her husband what she owes him.
But if she separates, let her remain that way or be reconciled to her husband. And the husband must not leave his wife.
You were bought at a price. Do not become slaves of people.
Anyone who says, "I know something," does not yet know as one ought to know.
But God was not pleased with most of them, for they were scattered in the wilderness.
Or shall we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he is?
Let no one seek his own benefit, but that of someone else.
Nevertheless, in the Lord there is no woman without man, nor man without woman.
And there are different kinds of activity, but it is the same God who brings about everything in everyone.
So that there may be no division in the body, but that the members may care for one another.
Now you are the body of Christ, and individually his members.
As the one who is from the earth is, so are those who are from the earth; and as the one who is from heaven is, so are those who are from heaven.
For a great door for effective work has opened for me, and there are many opponents.
If anyone does not love our Lord, let him be accursed. Our Lord, come!
